description: Fixture (ACCDB), CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, 128). NU(ID Long primary key, B Byte, I2 Integer, L Long, S Single, D Double, C Currency, DT Date, GU Guid, X Decimal added by TableDef.CreateField("X", 20), DX DATETIME2 by ALTER TABLE); every value is stored in its own row (other columns Null) through a table-type recordset: byte 0/1/127/128/255 and refused out-of-range inputs; integer and long extrema and zero; single and double extrema, +-0, subnormals and attempted NaN and infinities by bit pattern; Currency from Cy, Double, string and Long projections of one amount; negative DATE fractions and Double projection of the same instant; component-distinct GUIDs; Decimal magnitude, sign and scale; extended-date neighbors. One index per column is built after the rows (images kept). Then closes, reopens the output read-only and reads the stored rows (ID order) and the forward traversal of every column index, backward for D and C. Asks the stored value, key order and Null placement of each type, and what the public path admits.

args.text: CREATE TABLE NU (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_NU PRIMARY KEY, B BYTE, I2 SHORT, L LONG, S SINGLE, D DOUBLE, C CURRENCY, DT DATETIME, GU GUID)
ALTER TABLE NU ADD COLUMN DX DATETIME2
SELECT * FROM NU ORDER BY ID
